title: build_providers does not apply model override from preset:model spec

finding.claim: build_providers does not apply model override from preset:model spec
finding.recommendation: Extract the model override after the colon when a preset:model suffix is present, similar to how describe_spec handles it. After computing nm, check if the original spec contains ':' and a non-empty model_override, and use that model instead of the registry default.

refutation.reason: build_provider now derives the parsed description from describe_spec(spec) and explicitly replaces the preset default with desc["model"], which includes any preset:model override.

probe.summary: Stub-payload re-run at HEAD (`probes/stub_payload_rerun.py`, result `stub-payload-e1e22d48db4d.txt`): the three suite tests that assert the payload model field pass (test_openai_compatible_presets, test_model_override_and_temperature_quirk, test_openai_compatible_escape_hatch), and direct stub captures show payload['model'] for a preset, for a preset:model override ('deepseek-reasoner'), and for the custom escape-hatch spec ('my-model').
